entities.name: Query protein 587 aa
observations: Sequence length is 587 aa; estimated molecular mass 63.54 kDa; theoretical pI 7.998; predicted charge at pH 7 is +3.35.
Pfam identifies Adenylsucc_synt (PF00709.28) at residues 36–441 with i-Evalue 9.1e-178 and Siva (PF05458.18) at residues 440–587 with i-Evalue 1.1e-43.

The N-terminal 35 residues are glycine/proline/arginine-rich and likely disordered; the C-terminal region is cysteine-rich and zinc-binding-like by composition, but its exact role is not established by this analysis.
Sequence evidence supports adenylosuccinate synthetase as the primary enzymatic function, with a possible C-terminal Siva-like regulatory or interaction module.

entities.name: Adenylosuccinate synthetase
observations: Reviewed mammalian homologs show 88.9–91.0% identity over approximately 75.5% of the query and E-values of about 10^-297 to 10^-303.
Catalyzes IMP + L-aspartate + GTP → adenylosuccinate + GDP + phosphate + 2 H+; EC 6.3.4.4; Rhea RHEA:15753.
Binds one Mg2+ per subunit and commonly forms a homodimer; localized primarily in cytoplasm/cytosol.
Participates in AMP biosynthesis and purine nucleotide metabolism.
